title: Favorites
intro: Your wishlist: products you want next time, stalls you go back to, and the markets you shop at. A sold-out favorite tells you when it is back.

banner.title: One of your four saved products is sold out.
banner.text: Restock alerts are on, so you get a notification the moment the stall lists it again.

addInStock_one: Add the {{count}} in-stock item to cart
addInStock_other: Add the {{count}} in-stock items to cart

toast.addedMany_one: Added {{count}} product to your cart. It will be split by stall at checkout.
toast.addedMany_other: Added {{count}} products to your cart. They will be split by stall at checkout.

holdNote: Saving a product does not hold any stock. It is held only when you place the order.
stallsNote: Your saved stalls, with what each one is bringing this weekend.
marketsNote: A saved market comes first in lists and on the map, and directions to its stalls start from your saved address.
